Entra in un brutale mondo post-apocalittico ispirato all’universo visionario della band metal Voivod. In questo action-adventure metroidvania affronterai orrori biomeccanici, esplorerai paesaggi in continuo mutamento e cercherai di ricomporre una realtà che sta rapidamente andando in pezzi.
        
   Storia   Sei il  Voivod , un guerriero perduto in una landa da incubo fatta di devastazione nucleare, orrori meccanici e dimensioni mutevoli. Il tuo corpo è in continua mutazione e, in questo processo, hai perso il senno. Ora, guidato dalla tua coscienza disincarnata,  Nothingface , devi recuperare i frammenti della tua memoria dispersi in questo mondo surreale. Solo quando tutti i pezzi saranno ritrovati potrai sperare di fuggire da questo orrore cosmico.
        
  Esplora paesaggi devastati dalla guerra, infiltra fortezze cibernetiche e affronta creature distorte ispirate alla mitologia dei Voivod. Ogni ambiente e nemico è stato progettato per riflettere l’estetica unica della band, immergendo i giocatori in un viaggio tanto caotico quanto esaltante.
        
   Caratteristiche principali      Combattimento run-and-gun frenetico  – Affronta abomini cibernetici e signori della guerra intergalattici.
     Esplorazione in stile Metroidvania  – Sblocca nuove abilità per navigare in una realtà frammentata.
     Boss ispirati ai Voivod  – Combatti mostri ispirati alle iconiche copertine degli album della band.
     Grafica pixel-art retrò  – Un'estetica oscura e d'atmosfera che richiama i classici action-platformer anni ‘90.
     Colonna sonora Voivod esclusiva  – Brani della lineup attuale riadattati per un sound  da videogioco vintage.
          
   Coinvolgimento della band   Questo gioco non è solo un tributo, è una vera e propria collaborazione con i Voivod, che partecipano attivamente per garantire che il mondo, la musica e la direzione artistica siano fedeli al loro universo.
     Michel Langevin (Away)  contribuisce alla grafica e alla direzione artistica del gioco.
     Daniel Mongrain (Chewy)  supervisiona l’adattamento della musica dei Voivod nel formato retro-game.
     Denis Bélanger (Snake)  presta la sua voce al protagonista.
     Dominic Laroche (Rocky)  testa il gioco e fornisce feedback sul gameplay.

game.title: Enotria: The Last Song
game.description:
Enotria: The Last Song is a soulslike set in a beautiful sun-lit world inspired by Italian folklore where the brightest sun casts the darkest shadow. Wear unique role-altering masks, face formidable foes and alter reality with the power of Ardore to unravel the secrets of Enotria.

The Universe is a Story, which unfolds and weaves the ever-changing tapestry, making up Reality Itself, Until a group of extraordinary individuals, used the power of the Story to trap it on paper – creating the Canovaccio.
The world has since degraded, becoming an empty – yet beautiful – husk…

game.title: ASTRONEER
game.description:
Astroneers undergo rigorous training to explore the frontiers of outer space for the good of all humankind. Creativity and ingenuity are key to their survival!
  
   RESHAPE THE ENVIRONMENT         
  Astroneers are trained to use the Terrain Tool, a powerful instrument which can dig, collect, shape, build, and color terrain in any way they wish.
  
   GO HANDS-ON WITH BASEBUILDING         
  Build custom bases throughout the solar system to survive and thrive anywhere! Objects are snapped into place in a modular system that allows Astroneers to create unique builds. Automation systems, crafting stations, power plants, resource harvesters, and railway facilities are built from the ground up and can be customized to suit any situation.

   LEARN TO SURVIVE A STRANGE SOLAR SYSTEM         
  This unrecognized system consists of seven celestial bodies. Each of them can be explored entirely, from the rounded surface all the way down into the core. Astroneers will have to grapple with their unique geography and challenging biomes if they seek to understand them.
  
   UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF THE UNIVERSE         
  These strange worlds are dotted with mysterious structures and artifacts, while Astroneers themselves receive confusing comms from unknown sources. Curious Astroneers may seek to understand these anomalies, and with them, the secrets of the solar system.
  
   ALONE OR TOGETHER         
  While they're perfectly capable on their own, Astroneers are team players who are always happy to offer a helping hand! Group up with other Astroneers and work together in 2-4 player online co-op. Playing solo online allows fellow Astroneers to drop in and out of your world at their leisure.
   
WHERE WE ARE   
Astroneer began as an Early Access title on Steam in 2016, and reached 1.0 in 2019. We wouldn't be here today if not for our community's support, feedback, and ideation. As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

Los Astroneers se someten a un riguroso entrenamiento para explorar las fronteras del espacio exterior por el bien de la humanidad. ¡La creatividad y el ingenio son la clave de su supervivencia!
 
   REMODELA EL ENTORNO         
  Los Astroneers han aprendido a usar la herramienta de terreno, un poderoso instrumento que les permite cavar, recoger, moldear, construir y colorear el terreno como deseen.
 
   CONSTRUYE BASES DE FORMA ACTIVA         
  Construye bases personalizadas por todo el sistema solar para poder sobrevivir y prosperar en cualquier lugar. Los objetos encajan unos con otros mediante un sistema modular que permite a los Astroneers crear construcciones únicas. Los sistemas de automatización, las estaciones de fabricación, las centrales energéticas, las cosechadoras de recursos y las instalaciones ferroviarias se construyen de cero y se pueden personalizar para adaptarse a cualquier situación.
   
   APRENDE A SOBREVIVIR EN UN SISTEMA SOLAR EXTRAÑO         
  Este sistema no reconocido contiene siete cuerpos celestes; cada uno de ellos se puede explorar por completo, desde la superficie esférica hasta el núcleo. Los Astroneers tendrán que lidiar con su geografía única y los desafiantes biomas si quieren llegar a comprenderlos. 
  
   DESCUBRE LOS MISTERIOS DEL UNIVERSO         
  En estos mundos tan extraños se pueden encontrar estructuras y artefactos misteriosos, y los Astroneers reciben mensajes confusos de fuentes desconocidas. Los más curiosos intentarán comprender estas anomalías y, a la vez, descubrir los secretos del sistema solar.
   
   A SOLAS O EN COMPAÑÍA         
  Aunque los Astroneers son perfectamente capaces de apañárselas sin ayuda, les gusta colaborar con otros y siempre están más que dispuestos a echarse una mano. Forma equipo con otros Astroneers y colaborad en el modo cooperativo en línea para 2-4 jugadores. Si juegas a solas en línea, otros Astroneers podrán entrar y salir de tu mundo a su antojo.
   
   DÓNDE ESTAMOS   
Astroneer empezó como un título de acceso anticipado en Steam en 2016, y la versión 1.0 se publicó en 2019. No estaríamos aquí hoy si no fuera por el apoyo, los comentarios y las sugerencias de nuestra comunidad. A medida que proseguimos nuestra aventura, queremos reiterar que estamos comprometidos a seguir ampliando de forma continua la base que es Astroneer con actualizaciones de contenido gratuitas.

Les Astroneers suivent un entraînement rigoureux afin d'explorer les frontières de l'espace pour le bien de l'humanité. La créativité et l'ingéniosité sont les clés de leur survie !  
  
   REMODELEZ L'ENVIRONNEMENT         
  Les Astroneers sont formés à l'utilisation de l'outil Terrain, un puissant instrument qui leur permet de creuser, récolter, façonner, construire et colorer le terrain à leur guise.
   
   CONSTRUISEZ DES BASES SUR MESURE         
  Construisez des bases personnalisées dans tout le système solaire pour survivre et prospérer ! Le système modulaire permet des créations uniques. Les systèmes d'automatisation, les stations d'artisanat, les centrales électriques, les collecteurs de ressources et les installations ferroviaires sont construits à partir de zéro et peuvent être personnalisés pour s'adapter à n'importe quelle situation.
   
   APPRENEZ À SURVIVRE DANS UN SYSTÈME SOLAIRE ÉTRANGE         
  Ce système méconnu est composé de sept corps célestes, chacun pouvant être exploré de la surface jusqu'au noyau. Les Astroneers devront se confronter à leur géographie unique et à leurs biomes complexes pour espérer les comprendre.
    
   DÉCOUVREZ LES MYSTÈRES DE L'UNIVERS         
  Ces mondes étranges sont parsemés de structures et d'artefacts mystérieux, tandis que les Astroneers eux-mêmes reçoivent des communications déroutantes de sources inconnues. Les plus curieux pourront chercher à comprendre ces anomalies afin de percer les secrets du système solaire.
   
   SEULS OU ENSEMBLE         
  Bien qu'ils soient parfaitement capables d'agir seuls, les Astroneers ont l'esprit d'équipe et sont toujours prêts à donner un coup de main ! Rejoignez jusqu'à 3 Astroneers et coopérez en ligne. Le mode solo en ligne permet aux autres Astroneers d'entrer et de sortir de votre monde à leur guise.
   
   ÉVOLUTION   
Astroneer a commencé en tant que titre en Early Access sur Steam en 2016, et a lancé sa version 1.0 en 2019. Nous ne serions pas là aujourd'hui sans le soutien, les commentaires et les idées de notre communauté. Pour la suite de notre voyage, nous voulons réitérer notre promesse de continuer à développer Astroneer avec des mises à jour de contenu gratuites et régulières.

Astroneers durchlaufen ein umfangreiches Training, um den Rand des Weltraums zum Wohle der Menschheit erkunden zu können. Kreativität und Einfallsreichtum sind der Schlüssel zu ihrem Überleben!
   
   GESTALTE DIE UMGEBUNG         
  Die Astroneers sind in der Nutzung des Terrain-Tools ausgebildet, eines mächtigen Instruments, mit dem sie nach Belieben graben, einsammeln, formen, errichten und einfärben können.
    
   BASISBAU AUS ERSTER HAND         
  Errichte eigene Basen im Sonnensystem, um überall zu überleben und aufzublühen! Objekte rasten dank eines modularen Systems an Ort und Stelle ein, wodurch die Astroneers einzigartige Bauwerke errichten können. Automatisierungssysteme, Herstellungsstationen, Kraftwerke, Ressourcenabbauer und Bahnanlagen können von Grund auf errichtet und an jede Situation angepasst werden.
   
   LERNE, IN EINEM FREMDEN SONNENSYSTEM ZU ÜBERLEBEN         
  Dieses unbekannte System besteht aus sieben Himmelskörpern, die alle von der Oberfläche bis zum Kern erkundet werden können. Die Astroneers werden sich mit ihrer einzigartigen Geografie und den herausfordernden Biomen auseinandersetzen müssen, wenn sie sie verstehen wollen.
  
    LÜFTE DIE GEHEIMNISSE DES UNIVERSUMS         
  Auf diesen fremden Welten gibt es geheimnisvolle Strukturen und Artefakte, während die Astroneers seltsame Nachrichten von unbekannten Quellen erhalten. Neugierige Astroneers können versuchen, mehr über diese Anomalien zu erfahren und die Geheimnisse des Sonnensystems zu lüften.
   
   ALLEINE ODER ZUSAMMEN         
  Obwohl die Astroneers auch alleine gut zurechtkommen, sind sie auch immer froh, anderen zur Hand gehen zu können! Schließe dich mit anderen Astroneers zusammen und spiele im Online-Koop-Modus mit Gruppen aus 2–4 Spielern. Und wenn du alleine online spielst, können andere Astroneers nach Belieben zu dir stoßen.
   
   WO WIR STEHEN   
Astroneer begann im Jahr 2016 als Early-Access-Spiel auf Steam und erreichte im Jahr 2019 Version 1.0. Ohne die Unterstützung und das Feedback der Community wären wir heute nicht hier. Während wir unsere Reise fortsetzen, möchten wir noch einmal bekräftigen, dass wir weiterhin mit kostenlosen Inhalts-Updates auf dem Fundament von Astroneer aufbauen wollen.

Os Astroneers são submetidos a treinos rigorosos para explorar os confins do espaço para o bem de toda a humanidade. A criatividade e a engenhosidade são fundamentais para a sobrevivência!
  
   REFORMULA O AMBIENTE         
  Os Astroneers são treinados para usar a Terrain Tool, uma poderosa ferramenta que te permite escavar, recolher, moldar, construir e colorir terreno como desejares.
  
   PÕE MÃOS À OBRA E CONSTRÓI UMA BASE         
  Cria bases personalizadas pelo sistema solar fora para sobreviver e prosperar onde quer que seja! Os objetos são ajustados ao seu lugar através de um sistema modular que permite aos Astroneers elaborar construções únicas. Sistemas de automação, estações de fabrico, centrais elétricas, coletores de recursos e estações ferroviárias são construídos de raiz e podem ser modificados para se adaptarem a qualquer situação.
   
APRENDE A SOBREVIVER A UM ESTRANHO SISTEMA SOLAR         
  Este sistema desconhecido consiste em sete corpos celestiais. Cada um pode ser explorado na íntegra, desde a sua superfície redonda até ao seu núcleo. Os Astroneers terão de enfrentar a sua geografia única e biomas desafiantes se os quiserem compreender.
  
   DESVENDA OS MISTÉRIOS DO UNIVERSO         
  Estes mundos estranhos incluem estruturas e artefactos misteriosos, e os próprios Astroneers recebem comunicações confusas de origens desconhecidas. Os Astroneers curiosos poderão procurar compreender estas anomalias e, com elas, os segredos do sistema solar.
  
   SOZINHO OU ACOMPANHADO         
  Embora sejam perfeitamente capazes sozinhos, os Astroneers são jogadores de equipa e ficam sempre felizes por oferecer uma mão amiga! Forma um grupo com outros Astroneers e trabalha numa equipa de 2–4 jogadores em cooperação online. Jogar a solo online permite aos Astroneers entrar e sair do seu mundo a seu bel-prazer.
  
 ONDE ESTAMOS   
Astroneer começou como um jogo de acesso antecipado no Steam em 2016 e chegou à versão 1.0 em 2019. Não estaríamos aqui hoje sem o apoio, os comentários e as ideias da nossa comunidade. Com o avançar da nossa viagem, queremos reiterar o nosso compromisso em continuar a construir os alicerces de Astroneer com atualizações de conteúdo grátis e contínuas.

Enhver Astroneer er omhyggeligt trænet til at udforske det ydre rums vilde vidder for menneskehedens bedste. Kreativitet og opfindsomhed er nøglen til at overleve!  
  
   OMFORM OMGIVELSERNE         
  En Astroneer er trænet til at bruge sit terrænværktøj, et mægtigt instrument, der kan grave, samle, forme, bygge og farve terræn efter forgodtbefindende.
   
   FÅ FINGRE I BASEBYGGERIET         
  Byg dine egne baser rundt omkring i solsystemet, så du kan overleve og trives overalt! Objekter bliver klikket på plads i et modulsystem, der lader en Astroneer skaber unikt byggeri. Automatiske systemer, håndværksstationer, kraftværker, ressourcehøstere og togfaciliteter bygges fra grunden og kan tilpasses enhver situation.
   
   LÆR AT OVERLEVE ET FORUNDERLIGT SOLSYSTEM         
  Dette ukendte system består af syv himmellegemer. Hver af dem kan udforskes frit fra den runde overflade helt ind til kernen. Som Astroneer må man kæmpe med deres unikke geografi og udfordrende biosfærer, hvis man vil forstå dem.
   
   AFDÆK UNIVERSETS MYSTERIER         
  Disse forunderlige verdener er overstrøet med mystiske bygninger og artefakter, og en Astroneer modtager forvirrende beskeder fra ukendte afsendere. En nysgerrig Astroneer kan forsøge at forstå disse uregelmæssigheder og dermed solsystemets hemmeligheder.
   
   ALENE ELLER SAMMEN         
  Selvom enhver Astroneer kan klare sig selv, så er de også holdspillere, der altid er klar til at give en hjælpende hånd! Slå dig sammen med andre i grupper på 2-4 spillere i online samarbejde. Hvis du spiller alene online, kan andre når som helst besøge og forlade din verden. 
  
   HVOR ER VI  
Astroneer startede i tidlig adgang på Steam i 2016 og nåede 1.0 i 2019. Vi ville ikke være her i dag, hvis det ikke var for vores spilleres støtte, kommentarer og idéer. Mens vi fortsætter vores rejse, vil vi gerne gentage vores løfte om fortsat at bygge videre på Astroneers fundament med gratis, fortsatte indholdsopdateringer.

Gli Astroneer vengono rigorosamente addestrati a esplorare le frontiere dello spazio cosmico per il bene di tutta l'umanità. La creatività e l'ingegno sono la chiave per la sopravvivenza!
   
   RIMODELLA L'AMBIENTE         
  Gli Astroneer sono addestrati a usare lo Strumento di terreno, un potente attrezzo per scavare, raccogliere, modellare, costruire e colorare il terreno in qualunque modo vogliano.
   
   CREA LA TUA PROPRIA BASE         
  Costruisci basi personalizzate in tutto il sistema solare per sopravvivere e prosperare ovunque! Gli oggetti si incastrano in un sistema modulare che consente agli Astroneer di creare strutture uniche. I sistemi di automatizzazione, le stazioni di creazione, le centrali energetiche, i raccoglitori di risorse e le strutture ferroviarie possono essere costruiti da zero e personalizzati in base alla situazione.
   
   IMPARA A SOPRAVVIVERE A UNO STRANO SISTEMA SOLARE         
  Questo sistema sconosciuto è costituito da sette corpi celesti completamente esplorabili, dalla superficie arrotondata fino al nucleo. Gli Astroneer dovranno affrontare la geografia unica e i biomi ostili di ogni pianeta per comprenderli appieno.
    
   SVELA I MISTERI DELL'UNIVERSO         
  Questi strani mondi sono disseminati di misteriose strutture e manufatti, mentre gli Astroneer captano comunicazioni confuse da fonti sconosciute. I più curiosi potrebbero voler comprendere queste anomalie, svelando al contempo i misteri del sistema solare.
   
   DA SOLI O INSIEME         
  Anche se sanno cavarsela da soli, gli Astroneer fanno gioco di squadra e sono sempre lieti di offrire il loro aiuto! Unisciti ad altri Astroneer e collabora con loro in sessioni online cooperative da 2 a 4 giocatori. Giocare da soli online consentirà ad altri fidati Astroneer di visitare e lasciare il tuo mondo a loro piacimento.
   
   IL NOSTRO VIAGGIO   Astroneer è nato nel 2016 come gioco ad accesso anticipato su Steam e ha raggiunto la versione 1.0 nel 2019. Non ce l'avremmo mai fatta senza il sostegno, il feedback e le idee della community. Mentre proseguiamo questo viaggio, vogliamo ribadire il nostro continuo impegno a costruire sulla base di Astroneer con costanti aggiornamenti gratuiti dei contenuti.

异星探险家接受着严格的训练，为全人类的利益探索外太空的边境。创造力与独创性是他们生存的关键！
  
  
   重塑环境         
  异星探险家接受过使用地形工具的训练，这种强大的工具可以按照使用者的意愿挖掘、收集、塑形及构建地形，并为其着色。
  
  
   亲手建造基地         
  在整个太阳系中建造定制的基地，以便在任何地方生存与发展！异星探险家通过模块化系统，可将物体快速拼接到位，创造出独特的建筑。自动化系统、制作站、发电厂、资源采集器、铁路设施，一切都是从零开始建造。并且可根据实际情况进行定制。
  
  
   学会在陌生的太阳系中生存         
  这个未知的星系由七个天体所组成。每个天体从地表一直到地心，都可以进行完整的探索。而想要了解它们，异星探险家就必须与其独特的地理环境及充满挑战的生物群落作斗争。
  
  
   揭开宇宙神秘的面纱         
  这些奇异的世界遍布着神秘的建筑和遗物，而异星探险家本身也会收到不明来源发来的让人百思不得其解的通讯。好奇的异星探险家或许会试图了解这些异象，以及太阳系的秘密。
  
  
   独自一人或与好友一起         
  虽然异星探险家各个独当一面，但他们也是乐于助人的团队合作者！与其他异星探险家组队，在2-4人在线合作模式中通力协作。单人游玩在线模式可允许其他异星探险家随意进出你的世界。
  
  
   我们的定位   《Astroneer》在2016年在Steam上架了抢先体验版，并于2019年推出1.0版本。而我们今天的成功也少不了社区的支持、反馈与意见。随着旅程的持续推进，我们将信守诺言，以《Astroneer》为基础，持续发布免费的内容更新。

Astroneerたちは全人類のために宇宙の辺境を探索する厳しい訓練を受けます。サバイバルの鍵となるのは創造力と発想力です！
  
  
   環境を作り変えよう         
  AstroneerたちはTerrain Toolを使用する訓練を受けています。これは地形をあなたの望みどおりに掘ったり、集めたり、形作ったり、構築したり、色を付けることができる強力なツールです。
  
  
   基地構築を実践しよう         
  場所を問わずに生き延びて繫栄できるように、星系中にカスタマイズした基地を建設しましょう！ オブジェクトはモジュラーシステムで所定の位置にスナップされるので、ユニークなビルドが可能になります。自動化システム、クラフトステーション、動力プラント、リソース収集機、鉄道施設をゼロから造り上げ、さまざまな状況に合わせてカスタマイズできます。
  
  
   見知らぬ星系でのサバイバルを学ぼう         
  この未確認の星系は7つの天体で構成されています。その丸い地表から核まで、それぞれの天体を隅々まで探索することが可能です。Astroneerたちはそのユニークな地形や困難なバイオームに立ち向かい、それを理解する必要があります。
  
  
   宇宙のミステリーを解き明かそう         
  これらの見知らぬ世界には謎めいた建造物やアーティファクトが点在しており、Astroneerたちも未知の発信源から不思議な通信を受信します。好奇心あふれるAstroneerたちは、これらの異常現象を調査し、星系の秘密を解き明かすことが可能です。
  
  
   ソロで、または一緒に冒険         
  Astroneerたちは独りでも任務を成し遂げられますが、彼らはチームプレイヤーでもあり、いつでも喜んで手助けしてくれます！ 2～4人のオンライン協力プレイで他のAstroneerたちとグループを組みましょう。ソロでもオンラインでプレイすれば、他のAstroneerたちが自由にあなたの世界に出入り可能になります。
  
  
   現在の開発状況   Astroneerは2016年にSteamで早期アクセスタイトルとしてスタートし、2019年に1.0に到達しました。コミュニティーからのサポートやフィードバック、アイデアの提案がなければ、ここまで来ることは不可能でした。この旅を続けるなかで、今後も基礎の上に構築を続けて、Astroneerに無料のコンテンツアップデートを提供し続けるという誓いを新たにします。

game.brief:
Astroneers undergo rigorous training to explore the frontiers of outer space for the good of all humankind. Creativity and ingenuity are key to their survival!
  
   RESHAPE THE ENVIRONMENT         
  Astroneers are trained to use the Terrain Tool, a powerful instrument which can dig, collect, shape, build, and color terrain in any way they wish.
  
   GO HANDS-ON WITH BASEBUILDING         
  Build custom bases throughout the solar system to survive and thrive anywhere! Objects are snapped into place in a modular system that allows Astroneers to create unique builds. Automation systems, crafting stations, power plants, resource harvesters, and railway facilities are built from the ground up and can be customized to suit any situation.

   LEARN TO SURVIVE A STRANGE SOLAR SYSTEM         
  This unrecognized system consists of seven celestial bodies. Each of them can be explored entirely, from the rounded surface all the way down into the core. Astroneers will have to grapple with their unique geography and challenging biomes if they seek to understand them.
  
   UNCOVER THE MYSTERIES OF THE UNIVERSE         
  These strange worlds are dotted with mysterious structures and artifacts, while Astroneers themselves receive confusing comms from unknown sources. Curious Astroneers may seek to understand these anomalies, and with them, the secrets of the solar system.
  
   ALONE OR TOGETHER         
  While they're perfectly capable on their own, Astroneers are team players who are always happy to offer a helping hand! Group up with other Astroneers and work together in 2-4 player online co-op. Playing solo online allows fellow Astroneers to drop in and out of your world at their leisure.
   
WHERE WE ARE   
Astroneer began as an Early Access title on Steam in 2016, and reached 1.0 in 2019. We wouldn't be here today if not for our community's support, feedback, and ideation. As we continue on our journey, we want to reiterate our pledge to continue building on the foundation that is Astroneer with free, ongoing content updates.

Steins;Gate is a Japanese visual novel developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus. It is the second game in the Science Adventure series following Chaos;Head. The game is described by the development team as a "hypothetical science ADV" and explores time and time travel in 2010 Akihabara. The gameplay follows non-linear plot lines which offer branching scenarios with courses of interaction.

The story of Steins;Gate takes place in Akihabara and is about a group of friends who have customized their microwave into a device that can send text messages to the past. As they perform different experiments, an organization named SERN who has been doing their own research on time travel tracks them down and now the characters have to find a way to avoid being captured by them.

 STEINS;GATE is the award-winning time travel science-fiction interactive visual novel developed by 5pb. and Nitroplus.
 It is widely considered to be one of the finest Visual Novels ever made.
 
 STEINS;GATE follows a rag-tag band of tech-savvy young students who discover the means of changing the past via mail, using a modified microwave. Their experiments into how far they can go with their discovery begin to spiral out of control as they become entangled in a conspiracy surrounding SERN, the organisation behind the Large Hadron Collider, and John Titor who claims to be from a dystopian future.
 
 Interaction with the game takes place through the “phone trigger” system, where the player can receive calls and text messages and decide whether to reply to them or not, changing the outcome of the game’s plot.

   Phone Trigger System - Interact via Rintaro’s cellphone to answer or ignore calls, and send and recieve emails. Your everday choices in life steer the story!

STEINS;GATE es la galardonada novela visual interactiva de ciencia ficción sobre viajes en el tiempo desarrollada por 5pb. y Nitroplus.
 
Se la considera una de las mejores novelas visuales de todos los tiempos.
 

 
STEINS;GATE cuenta la historia de una banda de brillantes estudiantes que descubren los medios tecnológicos para cambiar el pasado a través del correo utilizando un microondas modificado. Sus experimentos sobre lo lejos que pueden llegar con su descubrimiento comienzan a descontrolarse cuando se ven envueltos en una conspiración en la que está implicada la SERN, la organización responsable del Gran Colisionador de Hadrones, y John Titor, quien dice venir de un futuro distópico.
 

 
La interacción con el juego se realiza a través del sistema de “activación por teléfono”, en el que el jugador puede recibir llamadas y mensajes de texto y decidir si responder o no, cambiando el resultado de la trama del juego.

Sistema de activación por teléfono: interactúa a través del teléfono móvil de Rintaro para responder o rechazar llamadas y enviar y recibir correos electrónicos. ¡Tus elecciones diarias dirigirán la historia!

STEINS;GATE est le roman visuel interactif de science-fiction primé à base de voyages dans le temps développé par 5pb. et Nitroplus.
 
Il est considéré par beaucoup comme l'un des plus grands romans visuels jamais créés.
 

 
STEINS;GATE relate les aventures d'une bande disparate de jeunes étudiants technophiles qui découvrent le moyen de changer le passé via les messages électroniques, en utilisant un micro-ondes modifié. En cherchant à découvrir jusqu'où il peuvent pousser leur découverte, ils perdent peu à peu le contrôle de leurs expériences et se retrouvent empêtrés au sein d'un complot autour du CERN, l'organisation responsable de la création du Grand collisionneur de hadrons, et de John Titor, un individu qui prétend venir d'un futur dystopique.
 

 
Les interactions avec le jeu ont lieu via le système de « téléphone déclencheur », au sein duquel le joueur peut recevoir des appels et des SMS et décider d'y répondre ou non, ce qui modifie le déroulement du jeu.

Roman visuel non-linéaire – découvrez plusieurs dénouements différents qui résultent des choix que vous avez effectués en jeu.
 
HD 1080P – Profitez du jeu avec des graphismes et des illustrations en HD.
 
Système de téléphone déclencheur – Interagissez via le téléphone portable de Rintaro pour répondre à des appels ou les ignorer, ainsi qu'envoyer et recevoir des e-mails. Vos décisions dans votre vie quotidienne orientent l'histoire !

STEINS;GATE ist die preisgekrönte interaktive visuelle Sciencefiction-Novelle mit Zeitreiseelementen, die von 5pb. und Nitroplus entwickelt wurde.
 
Es wird allgemein als eine der besten aller jemals erschienenen japanischen Adventures betrachtet. 
 

 
STEINS;GATE folgt einer wilden Truppe technikaffiner junger Leute, die entdecken, wie man die Vergangenheit mittels eines umgebauten Mikrowellenherds per Textnachrichten verändern kann. Ihre Experimente, wie weit man mit dieser Entdeckung gehen kann, geraten jedoch außer Kontrolle, als sie in eine Verschwörung im Umfeld von SERN verwickelt werden, der Organisation, die hinter dem Großen Hadronenspeicherring und John Titor steckt, der sich als eine Art dystopische Zukunftsform präsentiert.
 

 
Interagiert mit dem Spiel wird mittels des „Phone Trigger“-Systems, bei dem der Spieler Anrufe und Textnachrichten erhält und entscheidet, ob er darauf antworten will oder nicht und dadurch die Handlung des Spiels beeinflusst.

Ein nichtlineares visuelles Adventure – Entdecke mehrere verschiedene Arten, wie die Geschichte enden kann, in Abhängigkeit von deinen Entscheidungen während des Spiels.

STEINS;GATE segue una banda di giovani studenti esperti in tecnologia che scopre il modo di cambiare il passato con delle email, usando un microonde modificato. Sperimentano fin quanto si possono spingere quando la loro scoperta sfugge loro di mano mentre restano invischiati in una cospirazione che coinvolge il SERN, l'organizzazione dietro il Large Hadron Collider, e John Titor, che sostiene di provenire da un futuro distopico.

命运石之门（Steins;Gate）的Steins德语的意思是石头，音译：斯坦因）。强调：在故事中，名词创造者本人——冈部伦太郎/凤凰院凶真明确地指出：这个名词是没有任何含义的，与任何人和事件亦或者物件无关，而没有含义才导致了它却是本作最终的关键词。

5pb.Games于2008年推出了由社长志仓千代丸亲自企划并担当制作人的科学幻想作品[Chaos;Head]后，取得了非凡的成功与不俗的成绩。在改编为新番动画后人气更是经久不衰，在2009年年初推出的“增强完整版”性质的[Chaos;Head Noah]在次时代主机Xbox360上首周竟也卖出万套以上。携此作的空前成功之势，5pb.Games在2009年10月15日推出同系列新作[Steins;Gate]，前作的核心团队新加入话题人物组成了更强的制作团队。本作在发售后取得了超高的人气，超高的口碑与超高的销量。可以视为5pb.游戏分公司成立以来最为成功的一款作品。而其制作人志仓千代丸、剧本家林直孝也因此成为了人气飙升的话题人物。

命运石之门

冈部伦太郎–中二病的大学生，自称疯狂科学家-凤凰院凶真。他在“未来机械研究所”里发明了“电话烤箱（暂定）”，这个道具有着是类似时空旅行的惊人机能，能够对过去寄送电子邮件。某日，主角遇到了18岁的天才少女-牧瀬红莉栖，但是，就在数个小时前，主角才亲眼目击到她在大厦的屋顶遭到杀害…故事由此展开。

game.description:
After the mysterious death of his father and his younger sister Juri, Itsuki, now suffering from amnesia, moves back to his hometown with his stepmother. There he meets an enigmatic young girl dressed in a crimson red kimono named Kurame, and the two soon become friends. The strange thing is, Kurame looks exactly like his younger sister Juri...

On the surface, Itsuki's family and friends all appear to be rooting for his full recovery. However, deep inside, they also seem to be burdened with secrets and guilt about the past. In the span of four days, Itsuki's memories will slowly return as he struggles between his loss and his fear of the truth, until the fourth night, when the whole world becomes blanketed under a red sheet of snow and wrapped up in the silence of death....

  About the Game FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE is a bold reimagining of the original FINAL FANTASY VII, originally released in 1997, developed under the guidance of the original key developers.
 This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional command-based combat and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with FF7R EPISODE INTERmission─a new story arc featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.
 
 * This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
 The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new elements.
 
    
 
 ■FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)
 
 FF7R EPISODE INTERmission is a brand-new adventure in the world of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE. Play as Wutaian ninja Yuffie Kisaragi as she infiltrates Midgar and conspires with Avalanche HQ to steal the ultimate materia from the Shinra Electric Power Company.
 
    
 
 ■Content included in this product
 
 FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE contains the following content:
 - FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE full game
 - DLC "FF7R EPISODE INTERmission" (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)
 - Weapon: Cacstar
 - Armor: Midgar Bangle
 - Armor: Shinra Bangle
 - Armor: Corneo Armlet
 - Accessory: Superstar Belt
 - Accessory: Mako Crystal
 - Accessory: Seraphic Earrings
 - Summon materia: Carbuncle
 - Summon materia: Chocobo Chick
 - Summon materia: Cactuar
 
 *The additional weapons, armor, accessories and summon materia can be obtained from the Gift Box on the main menu.
 *The weapon "Cacstar" can only be used in FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (Yuffie episode)

  关于游戏 《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》由1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》主要原班人马精心打造。
 因跌宕起伏的剧情与充满魅力的角色，以及运用当时最先进技术制作的画面，而深受众多玩家喜爱的不朽名作，如今将重生为“全新故事”。
 指令式战斗融合操作直觉的动作系统，衍生出更丰富的战略性，并运用现代CG技术重现身临其境般的《FINAL FANTASY VII》世界。
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 抽取自星球的生命能源──魔晄。
 在“米德加”这个拥有八座魔晄炉的阶层都市，
 凭借魔晄掌握世界的巨型企业“神罗公司”与为了保护星球挺身而出的反神罗组织“雪崩”爆发激烈冲突。
 前神罗战士克劳德，以佣兵的身份参加雪崩的“壹号魔晄炉引爆作战”。
 魔晄炉爆炸的巨响响彻第捌区。
 陷入火海的城镇中，出现那位已故死敌飘渺的幻影。
 克劳德追着渴望消除的昔日幻影，最后与她相遇。
 卖花女递出一朵黄花，
 花语是“重逢”。
 刹那间，一团黑影──“命运守望者”将两人包围。
 现在，心念将再次于星球流转。
 
 ※本作为1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》之重制版。
 以原作中直到逃离米德加的剧情为基础，加入全新原创内容，是预计推出多部系列作的首部作品。

  ゲームについて 1997年に発売された『FINAL FANTASY VII』主要スタッフが手掛ける『FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE』。
 壮大な物語や魅力的なキャラクター、当時の最先端技術が駆使された映像で多くの人を魅了した不朽の名作が、時を経て「新たな物語」として生まれ変わります。
 コマンドバトルと直感的アクションが融合することで戦略性は高くなり、現代のグラフィック技術によって『FINAL FANTASY VII』の世界をリアルに再現、再生しております。
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 星から吸い上げた生命エネルギー《魔晄》。
 《ミッドガル》――八基の魔晄炉を有する階層都市。
 魔晄によって世界を掌握した巨大企業《神羅カンパニー》と星を守るために立ち上がった反神羅組織《アバランチ》が激突する。
 元ソルジャーのクラウドは、傭兵としてアバランチの《壱番魔晄炉爆破作戦》に参加していた。
 魔晄炉爆破の余韻響く八番街。
 炎に包まれる街で、死んだはずの宿敵の幻影が揺らめく。
 消し去りたい過去の幻影に導かれ、彼女と出会う。
 花売りの女性が差し出した黄色い花。
 花言葉は――《再会》
 その刹那、ふたりを取り囲む黒い影――《運命の番人》。
 今、想いが再び星を巡る。
 
 ※本作は1997年に発売された『FINAL FANTASY VII』のリメイク作品です。
 ミッドガル脱出までの原作を元にオリジナルの要素を加えた作品となり、複数作で展開予定の第1作目です。

 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.

 Este juego aclamado por la crítica combina el combate tradicional por turnos con la acción en tiempo real, y se ofrece ahora por primera vez en Steam junto con FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, una nueva historia con Yuffie Kisaragi como protagonista. 
 
    
 
 HISTORIA
 
 Mediante sus reactores succionadores de mako, la savia del planeta, la Compañía de Electricidad y Energía Shinra prácticamente se ha apoderado del mundo. Solo un grupo de idealistas conocido como Avalancha opone resistencia a su dominio.

 La explosión convierte la ciudad en un infierno, y Cloud sufre alucinaciones de su archienemigo, a quien creía muerto. 
 
 Así comienza, una vez más, la historia que definirá el destino de todo un mundo. 
 
 * Este juego es un remake de FINAL FANTASY VII, lanzado a la venta por primera vez en 1997.
 Es el primer título de una serie de juegos basados en la historia del juego original, y comprende los eventos hasta la huida de Midgar, incluyéndose además elementos adicionales.

  Informazioni sul gioco Dopo il FINAL FANTASY VII originale del 1997, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE è la grandiosa rivisitazione del gioco realizzata sotto la direzione dei principali sviluppatori dell'epoca.
 Accolto entusiasticamente, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE unisce dinamiche azioni in tempo reale a tradizionali combattimenti con i comandi e ora debutta su Steam insieme a FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, l'episodio con Yuffie Kisaragi come protagonista.
 
    
 
 TRAMA
 
 La compagnia elettrica Shinra sfrutta l'energia mako, linfa vitale del pianeta, per trasformarla in elettricità con i suoi reattori e, di fatto, sembra stringere in pugno le sorti del mondo. Ma non è così: a opporre resistenza c'è il gruppo di attivisti Avalanche.
 
 Per distruggere il reattore 1 a Midgar, l'Avalanche chiede aiuto a Cloud, ex membro dell'élite militare SOLDIER. L'operazione finisce con il gettare la città nel caos, mentre Cloud è tormentato dalle visioni del suo nemico, morto tempo addietro...
 
 È così che inizia la storia che cambierà il destino dell'umanità.
 
 Questo gioco è la versione rivisitata di FINAL FANTASY VII, uscito per la prima volta nel 1997.
 Come gioco a se stante e prima parte di un progetto più ampio, è basato sull'originale fino alla fuga da Midgar e arricchito di nuovi elementi.
 
    
 
 FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (nuovo episodio Yuffie)
 
 FF7R EPISODE INTERmission è la nuova avventura di FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE con protagonista Yuffie Kisaragi, la ninja di Wutai in missione segreta a Midgar dove, in collaborazione con il nucleo originario dell'Avalanche, intende impadronirsi dell'ultramateria della Shinra.

game.title: Cave Story
game.description:
Arguably the most well-known indie game of all time, Cave Story features a completely original storyline wrapped with personality, mystery and hours of fast-paced fun. Cave Story is an action-adventure game from the critically acclaimed independent designer, Daisuke Amaya--or Pixel to his fans. Overflowing with unmatched charm and character, Cave Story takes you into a rare world where a curious race of innocent rabbit-like creatures, called Mimigas, run free.
 						You wake up in a dark cave with no memory of who you are, where you came from or why you're in such a place. Uncovering Mimiga Village you discover that the once-carefree Mimigas are in danger at the hands of a maniacal scientist. The Mimigas’ only hope rest squarely on the shoulders of a quiet, amnesiac boy who can't remember his own name.
 						Run, jump, shoot, fly and explore your way through a massive action-adventure reminiscent of classic 8- and 16-bit games. Take control and learn the origins of this world’s power, stop the delusional villain and save the Mimiga!
 						 Key Features: 						  Original (320x240) graphics and upgraded “HD” graphics
 						  Remastered music as well as the original soundtrack
 						  Mix-and-match new/old artwork and music!
 						  Six new play modes (including Wind Fortress, Boss Rush and more!)
 						  Over 20 epic boss battles through Mimiga Island
 						  15 levels to explore in the vast world
 						  10 unique weapons to find and upgrade
 						  USB controller compatibility
 						  Four unique endings
 						  Future content updates

Podría decirse que es el juego indie más conocido de todos los tiempos. Cave Story nos ofrece una historia totalmente original con personalidad propia, misterio y horas de diversión a todo tren. Cave Story es un juego de acción y aventuras del diseñador independiente aclamado por la crítica Daisuke Amaya, o Pixel para sus fans. Con una personalidad y un encanto arrolladores, Cave Story te transporta a un extraño mundo en el que una curiosa raza de inocentes criaturas conejiles, llamadas Mimigas, campan en libertad.
 Te despiertas en una oscura cueva sin recordar quién eres, de donde vienes o por qué estás en este lugar. Al descubrir el Poblado Mimiga compruebas que los anteriormente despreocupados Mimigas se encuentran en peligro a manos de un científico maníaco. La única esperanza de los Mimigas descansa sobre los hombros de un silencioso chico amnésico que no recuerda ni su propio nombre.
 Corre, salta, dispara, vuela y explora a lo largo de una aventura de acción con el sabor de los clásicos de 8 y 16 bits. ¡Toma el control y descubre el origen del poder de este mundo, detén al iluso villano y salva a los Mimiga! Características Principales:   Gráficos originales (320x240) y gráficos “HD” mejorados
   Música remasterizada además de la banda sonora original
   ¡Mezcla a tu antojo los gráficos y música originales con los mejorados!
   Seis modos de juego (¡incluyendo Wind Fortress, Boss Rush y muchos más!)
   Más de 20 épicos encuentros con jefes a lo largo de la Isla Mimiga
   15 nieves a explorar en un enorme mundo
   10 armas únicas que encontrar y mejorar
   Compatible con controladores USB
   Cuatro finales únicos
   Futuras actualizaciones de contenido

Probablement l'un des jeux indépendants les plus connus de tous les temps, Cave Story offre une histoire totalement originale, entourée de personnalité, de mystère et d'heures d'amusement. Cave Story est un jeu d'action-aventure développé par le concepteur indépendant récompensé par la critique, Daisuke Amaya -- ou Pixel pour ses fans. Débordant d'un charme et d'un caractère sans pareils, Cave Story vous emporte dans un monde rare où une curieuse race de créatures innocentes ressemblant à des lapins, les Mimigas, est en toute liberté.
 Vous vous réveillez dans une caverne sombre sans souvenirs de qui vous êtes, d'où vous venez ou de pourquoi vous êtes dans un tel endroit. En découvrant Mimiga Village, vous vous apercevez que les insouciants Mimigas sont en danger, des mains d'un scientifique maniaque. Le seul espoir des Mimigas repose sur les épaules d'un garçon calme et amnésique qui ne peut pas se rappeler de son propre nom.
 Courez, sautez, tirez, volez et explorez à travers ce jeu d'action-aventure rappelant les classiques de l'époque 8- et 16-bit. Prenez le contrôle et apprenez les origines du pouvoir de ce monde, arrêtez le délirant méchant et sauvez les Mimiga ! Caractéristiques :   Graphismes originaux (320x240) et graphismes “HD” améliorés
   Musique remasterisée et présence de la bande son originale
   Mélangez à volonté anciennes/nouvelles illustrations et musiques !
   Six nouveaux modes de jeu (incluant Wind Fortress, Boss Rush et plus !)
   Plus de 20 combats épiques faces aux boss sur l'Île de Mimiga
   15 niveaux à explorer dans ce vaste monde
   10 armes uniques à trouver et à améliorer
   Compatible contrôleur USB 
   Quatre fins uniques
   Mises à jour du contenu à venir

Als wohl bekanntestes Indie Spiel aller Zeiten, beinhaltet Cave Story eine originelle Handlung mit Persönlichkeit, Mysterien und Stunden voller rasantem Spielspaß. Cave Story ist ein Action-Abenteuer Spiel des von der Kritik gefeierten Indie-Designers Daisuke Amaya -- von seinen Fans auch Pixel genannt. Vollgepackt mit unvergleichlichem Charme und Charakter, nimmt Cave Story Sie mit in eine einzigartige Welt, in der eine eigentümliche Rasse gutartiger kaninchenartiger Kreaturen, genannt Mimigas, frei herumläuft.
 Sie erwachen in einer dunklen Höhle, ohne Erinnerungen daran wer Sie sind, woher Sie kamen oder weshalb Sie sich an solch einem Ort befinden. Nachdem Sie das Mimiga-Dorf erreicht haben, finden Sie heraus, dass die einst sorgenfreien Mimigas sich aufgrund eines wahnsinnigen Wissenschaftlers in Gefahr befinden. Die einzige Hoffnung der Mimigas ruht auf den Schultern eines ruhigen Jungen ohne Gedächtnis, der sich nicht an seinem eigenen Namen erinnern kann.
 Laufen, Springen, Schießen, Fliegen und erforschen Sie ihren Weg durch ein massives Action-Abenteuer, erinnernd an klassische 8- und 16-Bit Spiele. Übernehmen Sie die Kontrolle und lernen Sie über die Enstehungen dieser Weltmacht, stoppen Sie den wahnhaften Schurke und retten Sie die Mimiga! Hauptmerkmale:   Originale (320x240) Grafik und verbesserte “HD” Grafik
   Überarbeitete Musik und der originale Soundtrack
   Kombination neuer/alter Grafik und Musik!

   Vier einzigartige Enden

Sem dúvida o mais conhecido jogo indie de todos os tempos, Cave Story apresenta uma história completamente original repleta de personalidade, mistério e horas de diversão num ritmo rápido. Cave Story é um jogo de ação e aventura do aclamado designer independente, Daisuke Amaya, conhecido como Pixel para os fãs. Cheio de charme e personalidade incomparáveis, Cave Story leva-te a um mundo invulgar onde uma curiosa raça de inocentes criaturas parecidas com coelhos, chamados Mimigas, correm livremente.
 Acordas numa caverna escura sem memória de quem és, de onde vens ou porque estás num lugar assim. Quando encontras a Vila Mimiga, descobres que os antes despreocupados Mimigas estão em perigo nas mãos de um cientista louco. A única esperança dos Mimigas assenta sobre os ombros de um sossegado e amnésico rapaz que não se consegue lembrar do próprio nome.
 Corre, salta, dispara, voa e explora através de um jogo de ação e aventura gigantesco que faz lembrar os clássicos jogos de 8 e 16 bit. Controla e descobre as origens do poder deste mundo, interrompe os planos do vilão malvado e salva os Mimiga! Características chave:   Gráficos originais (320x240) e gráficos “HD” melhorados
   Contém a banda sonora original e versões remasterizadas
   Combina a qualidade dos gráficos e das músicas como quiseres!

   Quatro finais diferentes
   Atualizações de conteúdo no futuro
洞窟物语 (洞窟物語, Doukutsu Monogatari, Cave Story) 是程序员 Pixel 花了自己5年的业余时间独立开发的免费的 2D 平台游戏。后被翻译成多种语言和移植到多个平台上，在全世界掀起了一股热潮。2008年（公布时间），洞窟物语将提升画质和音乐后，移植到 Wii 平台上。

Senza dubbio il gioco indie più famoso di sempre, Cave Story sfoggia una storia assolutamente originale condita di personalità, mistero e ore di frenetico divertimento. Cave Story è un gioco action-adventure realizzato dallo sviluppatore indipendente acclamato dalla critica, Daisuke Amaya -- o Pixel per i fan. Ricco di carisma e carattere, Cave Story vi condurrà in uno strano mondo dove una razza di curiose creature simili a innocenti coniglietti, chiamati Mimigas, scorrazzano liberi.
 Vi sveglierete in una caverna senza ricordare chi siete, da dove venite o perché vi trovate in un luogo simile. Esplorando il villaggio di Mimiga scoprirete che gli spensierati Mimiga sono ora minacciati da uno scienziato folle. Il destino dei Mimiga poggia interamente sulle spalle di un tranquillo ragazzino che soffre di amnesia e non riesce a ricordare neanche il suo nome. 
 Corri, salta, spara, vola e fatti strada in un intenso action-adventure ispirato ai classici giochi a 8 bit e 16 bit. Prendi il controllo e svela l'origine del potere di questo mondo, ferma i deliranti piani dello scienziato malvagio e salva i Mimiga! Caratteristiche Principali:   Grafica originale (320x240) e grafica moderna in  “HD” 
   Contiene sia la colonna sonora rimasterizzata sia l'originale
   Combinate assieme nuove e vecchie illustrazioni e musiche!
   Sei nuove modalità di gioco (incluse Wind Fortress, Boss Rush e molto altro!)
   Oltre 20 epici boss da affrontare sull'isola di Mimiga
   15 livelli da esplorare nel vastissimo mondo
   10 armi uniche da trovare e potenziare
   Compatibile con i controller USB
   Quattro finali diversi
   Prossimi aggiornamenti dei contenuti

game.title: Dwarf Fortress
game.description:
Prepare for the deepest, most intricate simulation of a world that has ever been created. 
     
  
     Not just generated geometry -- a whole simulated world. Generated rise and fall of civilizations, personalities, creatures, cultures, etc. Infinite hours of gameplay.
     Now with beautiful pixel graphics! 
     Learn the basics with in-game tutorials
     A lifetime “living” project - created/updated since 2003, with no end in sight
     Generate your unique world and manage a bustling colony of dwarves, even as they probably mine towards their eventual demise.
     A new endless hobby, just for you!
       
  The legendary Dwarf Fortress is now on Steam! Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive, despite threats of starvation, dragons, and madness.
     
  
  In this complex construction/management/roguelike simulation, every generated world brings a unique challenge, whether it’s dwarves with their own simulated personalities or aquifers. Observe what makes your civilization fall into eventual decline, and learn for next time… until something else inevitably goes wrong.
  
  The combat model includes skills, body parts, material properties, aimed attacks, wrestling, pain, nausea, various poison effects, and much more.
  
  It’s difficult to convey the depth of the generation. Hundreds of animals and monsters, many of which are randomly created for each world, as well as generated poetry, musical forms, instruments, and dances for your dwarves to practice and perform. A dynamic weather model tracks wind, humidity, and air masses to create fronts, clouds, storms, and blizzards. Over two hundred rock and mineral types can appear, in their proper geological environments.
  
   Remember: Losing is fun! 
     
  This is still good old Dwarf Fortress, but with graphics support and music provided. A few bells and whistles won’t change its essence.
  
  Classic Dwarf Fortress mod-artist Jacob "Ironhand" Bowman collaborated with artists Carolyn Jong and Neoriceisgood to create an all-new sprite pack for the game, which they continue to add to regularly.
  
  Dwarf Fortress also has hours of music in a two-volume soundtrack by Dabu and Simon Swerwer, including tracks in the Dwarvish language!  
  
  It's never been easier to start playing! We've improved the new player experience with the addition of tutorials to guide you through building your first fort and keeping your dwarves happy. 
   
    
  
  Command your dwarves as they search for wealth in their generated mountain. Your dwarves will need a steady supply of food and beer, but they’ll also need your guidance in surviving attacks from hostile civilizations, the wilderness, or even the dead.
  
     Craft treasures and furnitures from various materials
     Establish a barony and support the increasingly demanding nobility
     Read your dwarves’ thoughts to keep them happy
     Build floodgates to divert water for farming, and/or prevent magma mishaps
     Build structures and watch your dwarves discover and build their culture, like taverns, libraries, temples, honey, wax, pottery, animal training, bookbinding, and more.
 
    
      Go anywhere! Explore any civilization, earn a reputation, and recruit followers to join you
      Experience your fortress and the simulation in a new, more embodied way
    Explore mythical dungeons to find magical items, artifacts, and fill your quest journal
    Hints of mythology and magic as a start of future simulation enrichment to come
    An additional hour of music from Dabu and Simon Swerwer, presented as a second volume of the original soundtrack
       
    The original inspiration for RimWorld, Prison Architect, Minecraft and more. 
    One of the first video games acquired by the Museum of Modern Art in New York 
    Updated for over 16 years by two brothers, Tarn “Toady One” and Zach “Threetoe” Adams, and with the support of Kitfox Games since 2020.

localized_description.text: 有史以来最深邃、最复杂的模拟世界。建造一座堡垒，帮助你的矮人在这个深度生成的世界中生存下来。

注意： 本游戏目前仅支持英文 。开发者仍在调研本地化的可能性，但尚未能确定何时能支持简体中文版本。感谢各位的理解！ 
  
  
  
  准备好了吗？迎接史上最具深度与复杂性的世界模拟器。  
   
     
     这款游戏绝非仅仅在生成抽象的几何图形，而是在用算法编织一个完整自洽的模拟世界。在这里，你将见证文明的兴衰轮回，邂逅个性鲜活的虚拟生命，探索形态各异的生物，遭遇多姿多彩的文化。你几乎可以投入无尽的游玩时间。
    如今，矮人要塞已经支持精美的像素风格画面！
    通过游戏内置的教程，你将学会游戏的基本玩法。
    这是一个始终保持“鲜活”的终身项目——自2003年以来，我们一直在持续创造与更新，在可见的未来，游戏的开发都不会迎来尽头。
    生成独属你的世界，管理繁荣忙碌的矮人城邦，尽管，他们的文明可能会在无止境的探索中，逐步走向毁灭。
    一个专门为你打造，总有新鲜事物在等待你的全新爱好！ 
    
 
     
  传奇游戏《矮人要塞》现已登陆 Steam 平台！游戏中，你将肩负建设要塞的重任，引导矮人文明在饥荒、巨龙与疯病的重重威胁之中顽强生存。 
   
     
  这款融合了城市建设、经营管理、Roguelike 等元素的复杂模拟游戏中，每次生成的世界都独具特色，无论是性格迥异的矮人，还是包含水层的奇异地质结构。你将一次又一次亲眼见证文明的衰落，并从中汲取宝贵的经验教训……然而，新的问题总是会不可避免地再度爆发。
  游戏的战斗系统包含多样的模组，涵盖了技能、身体部位、材料属性、瞄准、摔跤、疼痛、恶心以多种中毒效果等丰富的元素。
  《矮人要塞》所构筑世界之深度，难以用语言清晰描述。多达数百种的动物与怪物，许多都是根据生成世界量身定做，更有随机生成的诗歌、音乐、乐器以及舞蹈，供矮人练习与演出。游戏还实现了动态气候模拟，包括风、湿度和气团等参数，从而呈现出冷锋、云层、暴风、暴血等多样的天气。在特定的地质条件下，你还能发现超过200种岩石与矿物资源。
   请记住：在《矮人要塞》中，即便失败，也能收获别样的乐趣。  
  
  
        
   
  这依然是那款经典的佳作《矮人要塞》，只是如今多了图形资源与音乐的支持。这些装饰无损于游戏的核心魅力，却能让游戏的呈现方式更加亲切和友好。
  《矮人要塞》经典版本的模组艺术家，如 Jacob "Ironhand" Bowman、Carolyn Jong 以及 Neoriceisgood 等人，携手合作，为游戏设计了全新的精灵图资源，他们仍在持续地定期更新。

  The legendary Dwarf Fortress is now on Steam! Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive, despite threats of starvation, dragons, and madness.
     
  
  In this complex construction/management/roguelike simulation, every generated world brings a unique challenge, whether it’s dwarves with their own simulated personalities or aquifers. Observe what makes your civilization fall into eventual decline, and learn for next time… until something else inevitably goes wrong.
  
  The combat model includes skills, body parts, material properties, aimed attacks, wrestling, pain, nausea, various poison effects, and much more.
  
  It’s difficult to convey the depth of the generation. Hundreds of animals and monsters, many of which are randomly created for each world, as well as generated poetry, musical forms, instruments, and dances for your dwarves to practice and perform. A dynamic weather model tracks wind, humidity, and air masses to create fronts, clouds, storms, and blizzards. Over two hundred rock and mineral types can appear, in their proper geological environments.

  In dieser komplexen Bau-/Management-/Roguelike-Simulation bringt jede generierte Welt eine einzigartige Herausforderung mit sich: ob Zwerge mit eigenen simulierten Charakteren oder Aquifer.
  Beobachte, was zum Untergang einer Zivilisation führt, und lerne fürs nächste Mal … bis wieder etwas schiefgeht.
  Das Kampfmodell umfasst Skills, Körperteile, Materialeigenschaften, gezielte Angriffe, Wrestling, Schmerz, Übelkeit, verschiedene Gifteffekte und vieles mehr.

   Nicht vergessen: Verlieren macht Spaß! 
  
     
  Dies ist nach wie vor das gute alte Spiel „Dwarf Fortress“, aber mit Grafiksupport und Musik. Ein bisschen Drum und Dran ändert seine Essenz nicht.
  Mod-Artist Jacob „Ironhand“ Bowman (klassisches „Dwarf Fortress“) hat mit Grafikern Carolyn Jong und Neoriceisgood zusammengearbeitet, um ein ganz neues Sprite-Set für das Spiel zu entwickeln, zu dem auch regelmäßig Neuheiten hinzukommen.
  Ein zweiteiliger Soundtrack von Dabu und Simon Swerwer bietet stundenlange musikalische Untermalung für „Dwarf Fortress“, einschließlich Tracks in der Zwergensprache!
  Noch nie war es einfacher, mit dem Spielen zu beginnen! Durch Einführung von Tutorials haben wir neuen Spielern den Einstieg erleichtert. Sie helfen dir, deine erste Festung zu bauen und dafür zu sorgen, dass deine Zwerge glücklich bleiben.
  
     
 
 
 
 Kommandiere deine Zwerge, während sie in ihrem generierten Berg nach Reichtümern suchen. Deine Zwerge müssen stetig mit Essen und Bier versorgt werden, aber darüber hinaus brauchen sie auch Hilfe, um Angriffe von feindlichen Zivilisationen, der Wildnis oder sogar den Toten zu überleben.
  
     Stelle aus verschiedenen Materialien Schätze und Mobiliar her
    Etabliere ein Baronat und unterstütze den immer anspruchsvolleren Adel
    Lies die Gedanken deiner Zwerge, damit sie glücklich bleiben
    Bau Schleusen, um Wasser für die Landwirtschaft umzuleiten und/oder Zwischenfälle mit Magma zu verhindern
    Erschaffe Bauten und beobachte, wie deine Zwerge ihre Kultur entdecken und weiterentwickeln – darunter Gasthäuser, Bibliotheken, Tempel, Honig, Wachs, Keramik, Training von Tieren, Buchbinderei und mehr. 
     
      Geh, wohin du willst! Erkunde jede beliebige Zivilisation, bau dir einen Ruf auf und rekrutiere Anhänger
    Erlebe deine Festung und die Simulation auf neue, verkörperte Art und Weise
    Erkunde mythische Dungeons, um magische Gegenstände und Artefakte zu finden, und fülle dein Quest-Journal
    Mit einem Hauch von Mythologie und Magie, die auf zukünftige Bereicherungen der Simulation hindeuten
    Eine zusätzliche Stunde Musik von Dabu und Simon Swerwer, präsentiert als zweiter Teil des Original-Soundtracks
    
     
    Die Original-Inspiration für RimWorld, Prison Architect, Minecraft und mehr.
    Eins der ersten Videospiele, das vom „Museum of Modern Art“ in New York angeschafft wurde
    16 Jahre lang von zwei Brüdern, Tarn „Toady One” und Zach „Threetoe” Adams, und seit 2020 mit Unterstützung von Kitfox Games aktualisiert

ATENÇÃO:  O jogo está disponível apenas em inglês no momento  .  Os desenvolvedores estão estudando a possibilidade de localização, mas ainda não há previsão de lançamento para a versão em português. Obrigado! 
  
  
  Prepare-se para a simulação de mundo mais detalhada e complexa já feita.  
   
  
     
     Não é apenas a geração da geometria estrutural — é um mundo inteiro simulado. Civilizações surgem e caem, personalidades, criaturas e culturas emergem... infinitas horas de jogo esperam por você.
   
     Agora com belos gráficos em Pixel Art!
   
     Aprenda o básico com tutoriais dentro do jogo
   
     Um projeto vivo em constante evolução — criado em 2003 e sem previsão de parar
   
     Crie um mundo exclusivo e gerencie uma colônia de anões enquanto eles cavam em direção ao próprio fim
   
     Um novo hobby infinito feito só para você!
    
  
      
   
  O lendário Dwarf Fortress chegou ao Steam! Construa uma fortaleza e tente ajudar seus anões a sobreviver, enfrentando a fome, dragões e a loucura.
   
   
     
  
  Nesta complexa simulação de construção, gerenciamento e estratégia, cada mundo gerado traz um desafio único — seja pela personalidade simulada dos anões ou por aquíferos inesperados. Observe as causas da queda da sua civilização e aprenda com seus erros para melhorar na próxima... até que algo inevitavelmente dê errado de novo.
  
   
   O sistema de combate inclui habilidades, membros do corpo, propriedades de materiais, ataques direcionados, agarrões, dor, náusea, efeitos variados de venenos e muito mais.
  
   
   A complexidade da geração procedural é impressionante. Há centenas de animais e monstros criados aleatoriamente para cada mundo, além de poesias, estilos musicais, instrumentos e danças geradas para os seus anões praticarem e apresentarem. Um sistema dinâmico de clima rastreia vento, umidade e massas de ar para criar frentes frias, nuvens, tempestades e nevascas. Mais de duzentos tipos de rochas e minerais podem surgir nos ambientes geológicos adequados.
  
   
    Lembre-se: perder faz parte da diversão! 
  
      
   
  Este ainda é o bom e velho Dwarf Fortress, agora com suporte a gráficos e trilha sonora. Alguns retoques visuais e sonoros não mudaram sua essência.
   
   O artista Jacob "Ironhand" Bowman, conhecido pelos mods clássicos de Dwarf Fortress, colaborou com Carolyn Jong e Neoriceisgood para criar uma nova versão, que continua a receber atualizações regularmente.
   
   O jogo também conta com horas de música em uma trilha sonora dividida em dois volumes, composta por Dabu e Simon Swerwer, incluindo faixas cantadas no idioma dos anões!
   
   Nunca foi tão fácil começar a jogar! Melhoramos a experiência para novos jogadores com tutoriais que te guiam na construção da sua primeira fortaleza e no cuidado dos seus anões.
  
       
    
   
  Governe os seus anões enquanto eles buscam riquezas em sua montanha exclusiva. Eles precisarão de um suprimento constante de comida e cerveja, mas também da sua liderança para sobreviver a ataques de inimigos, animais selvagens ou até mesmo de mortos-vivos.
   
     Crie tesouros e mobílias com os mais diversos materiais
   
     Estabeleça um baronato e atenda às exigências cada vez maiores da nobreza
   
     Leia os pensamentos dos seus anões para mantê-los felizes
   
     Construa comportas para desviar a água para a agricultura e/ou evitar desastres com o magma
   
     Erga estruturas e observe seus anões descobrirem e desenvolverem sua cultura com tavernas, bibliotecas, templos, mel, cera, cerâmica, adestramento de animais, encadernação de livros e muito mais.  
    
   
     
 
 
 Vá a qualquer lugar! Explore civilizações, ganhe reputação e recrute seguidores para sua jornada.
   
     Viva sua fortaleza e a simulação de uma forma mais imersiva
   
     Explore masmorras míticas em busca de itens mágicos e artefatos, e registre suas descobertas em seu diário de missões
   
     Elementos de mitologia e magia como um primeiro passo para futuras expansões da simulação
   
     Uma hora adicional de música composta por Dabu e Simon Swerwer, apresentada como o segundo volume da trilha sonora original
    
     
    A inspiração original por trás de jogos como RimWorld, Prison Architect, Minecraft e muitos outros.
   
     Um dos primeiros jogos eletrônicos adquiridos pelo Museu de Arte Moderna de Nova York
   
     Atualizado há mais de 16 anos pelos irmãos Tarn “Toady One” e Zach “Threetoe” Adams, com o apoio da Kitfox Games desde 2020.

注： 本作は現在英語でのみプレイ可能です。  開発者はローカライズを検討していますが、日本語サポートのリリース日は未定です。ご理解のほどよろしくお願いいたします！
 
 史上最も奥深く、最も複雑に作り込まれた世界のシミュレーションゲームに飛び込もう。   
  
    表面的な部分だけでなく、世界のすべてが表現されている。文明や人格、生物、文化などの盛衰が表現されていて、無限にプレイできる。
    美しいピクセルグラフィックで遊べるように！
    ゲーム内チュートリアルで基本を学べる
    2003年に制作されて以来更新し続けられている、終わりの見えない「生きた」プロジェクト
    独自の世界を作り出し、破滅に向かっているとも知らずに採掘を続けるドワーフたちの活気あるコロニーを管理
    終わりを知らない、君のための新しい趣味がここにある！
    
     
 
 伝説の『Dwarf Fortress』がSteamに登場！要塞を築き、ドワーフが飢饉やドラゴン、気が狂うかのような脅威から生き延びられるよう手を尽くそう。
  
     
   複雑な建築・管理・ローグライクシミュレーションで、毎回生成されるワールドに生まれるドワーフの性格や帯水層はさまざま。ワールドごとにチャレンジが発生する。文明が衰退したらその原因を観察し、次に備えよう…決定的な過ちを犯してしまうとすべてをやり直すことになる。
   
   戦闘にはスキル、体の部位、物質的特性、狙いを定めた攻撃、レスリング、痛みや吐き気、多様な毒効果などさまざまな要素がある。
   
   生成の奥深さを伝えきることはもはや不可能だ。何百もの動物やモンスターが各ワールドでランダムに生成され、ドワーフは詩、音楽、楽器、ダンスを練習したり、パフォーマンスしたりすることができる。気候もダイナミックに変動し、風や湿度、前線や雲や吹雪を形成する気団も存在する。地質環境によっては200種類以上の岩石や鉱物も出現する。
   
    覚えておいてほしい…Losing is fun―負けることは楽しい！ 
  
     
 
 以前の『Dwarf Fortress』の良さを残しつつ、グラフィックスや音楽をサポート。いくつか要素は追加されたが、本質は変わらない。
   
   オリジナル版『Dwarf Fortress』のModアーティストJacob "Ironhand" Bowman氏が、同じくアーティストのCarolyn Jong氏、Neoriceisgood氏と協力してまったく新しい要素がつまったパックを制作し、要素の追加も継続して行っている。
   
   『Dwarf Fortress』にはDabu氏やSimon Swerwer氏が手がけた何時間にもおよぶサウンドトラックを2作品、さらにはドワーフ語のトラックも収録！
   
   また、これまでになく手軽に遊び始められるようにもなった！最初の要塞を築く方法、ドワーフたちが幸せに生きられる方法についてチュートリアルを追加し、新規プレイヤーの体験を改善。
  
     
 
 ドワーフたちに、生成された山で富を探すよう命令しよう。ドワーフたちには定期的に食糧とビールを提供する必要があり、敵対する文明や荒野、死者からの攻撃の中で生き延びる術も指導しなければならない。
  
      さまざまな素材から宝物や家具を制作
     男爵領を確立し、ますます厳しい要求を送ってくる貴族を支援
     ドワーフの気持ちをくみ取り、幸せを維持してあげよう
     水門を建設して農業用水を引き、溶岩が流れる事故を防ぐ
    建物を建設し、ドワーフたちが酒場や図書館、寺院を建てたり、ハチミツに蝋、陶器づくり、動物の訓練、製本などの文化を発見し、築き上げていく様子を見守ろう。 
     
  
      どこへでも行ける！あらゆる文明を探検し、評判を獲得し、君に共鳴する信者を導こう
     要塞とシミュレーションを、新しくより具現化された世界で体験
     神話的なダンジョンを探索し、魔法のアイテムやアーティファクトを発見し、クエストジャーナルに記録していく
     神話や魔法はその先のシミュレーションの豊かさを表している
     Dabu氏、Simon Swerwer氏が手がけた曲が1時間分追加され、オリジナルサウンドトラックは2作収録されることに
       
    『RimWorld』、『Prison Architect』、『Minecraft』などにインスピレーションを与えた作品。
     ニューヨーク近代美術館が所蔵した最初のビデオゲームのひとつ。
     Tarn（Toady One）とZach Adams（Threetoe）という二人の兄弟が16年以上にわたって開発を続けており、2020年からKitfox Gamesのサポートを受けている。

game.brief:
Prepare for the deepest, most intricate simulation of a world that has ever been created. 
     
  
     Not just generated geometry -- a whole simulated world. Generated rise and fall of civilizations, personalities, creatures, cultures, etc. Infinite hours of gameplay.
     Now with beautiful pixel graphics! 
     Learn the basics with in-game tutorials
     A lifetime “living” project - created/updated since 2003, with no end in sight
     Generate your unique world and manage a bustling colony of dwarves, even as they probably mine towards their eventual demise.
     A new endless hobby, just for you!
       
  The legendary Dwarf Fortress is now on Steam! Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive, despite threats of starvation, dragons, and madness.
     
  
  In this complex construction/management/roguelike simulation, every generated world brings a unique challenge, whether it’s dwarves with their own simulated personalities or aquifers. Observe what makes your civilization fall into eventual decline, and learn for next time… until something else inevitably goes wrong.
  
  The combat model includes skills, body parts, material properties, aimed attacks, wrestling, pain, nausea, various poison effects, and much more.
  
  It’s difficult to convey the depth of the generation. Hundreds of animals and monsters, many of which are randomly created for each world, as well as generated poetry, musical forms, instruments, and dances for your dwarves to practice and perform. A dynamic weather model tracks wind, humidity, and air masses to create fronts, clouds, storms, and blizzards. Over two hundred rock and mineral types can appear, in their proper geological environments.
  
   Remember: Losing is fun! 
     
  This is still good old Dwarf Fortress, but with graphics support and music provided. A few bells and whistles won’t change its essence.
  
  Classic Dwarf Fortress mod-artist Jacob "Ironhand" Bowman collaborated with artists Carolyn Jong and Neoriceisgood to create an all-new sprite pack for the game, which they continue to add to regularly.
  
  Dwarf Fortress also has hours of music in a two-volume soundtrack by Dabu and Simon Swerwer, including tracks in the Dwarvish language!  
  
  It's never been easier to start playing! We've improved the new player experience with the addition of tutorials to guide you through building your first fort and keeping your dwarves happy. 
   
    
  
  Command your dwarves as they search for wealth in their generated mountain. Your dwarves will need a steady supply of food and beer, but they’ll also need your guidance in surviving attacks from hostile civilizations, the wilderness, or even the dead.
  
     Craft treasures and furnitures from various materials
     Establish a barony and support the increasingly demanding nobility
     Read your dwarves’ thoughts to keep them happy
     Build floodgates to divert water for farming, and/or prevent magma mishaps
     Build structures and watch your dwarves discover and build their culture, like taverns, libraries, temples, honey, wax, pottery, animal training, bookbinding, and more.
 
    
      Go anywhere! Explore any civilization, earn a reputation, and recruit followers to join you
      Experience your fortress and the simulation in a new, more embodied way
    Explore mythical dungeons to find magical items, artifacts, and fill your quest journal
    Hints of mythology and magic as a start of future simulation enrichment to come
    An additional hour of music from Dabu and Simon Swerwer, presented as a second volume of the original soundtrack
       
    The original inspiration for RimWorld, Prison Architect, Minecraft and more. 
    One of the first video games acquired by the Museum of Modern Art in New York 
    Updated for over 16 years by two brothers, Tarn “Toady One” and Zach “Threetoe” Adams, and with the support of Kitfox Games since 2020.

Visual novel adapted from the youth horror novel written by Hajime Ninomae and illustrated by Yoshitoshi ABe.

Yamada Nagito, a university student living away from home, needing a cheap place to live he finds out about a mysterious “House that grants wishes” on the market for a ridiculously low rent; he snaps up the house and starts living there. Afew nights in he starts hearing strange creaking noises. Each and every night he’s assaulted by these torturous noises. The last straw is when he finds the number 7 carved into the wall, as if counting down to something. Yamada having an interest in the occult seeks help from a website he frequently visits: “Ikaigabuchi”, which specialises in occult topics.
